description: A hearse, and then you stood

participation.context: Named the hearse, accepted the second act, and kept the account at three pence.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Answered, sat, and refused a third act.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Heard the walking from first light, and was not given a side.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Stayed at the foot of the stair, and did not ask the king's name.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

relations.note: she will take a death in the second act as sense
relations.quote: That is the most sensible thing you have yet done in a play.

story.body: She named the walk a hearse. You said you are dying in the second act. She called that sensible. You sat, and you left the third act unopened.

relations.note: she will take a death in the second act as sense
relations.quote: That is the most sensible thing you have yet done in a play.

title: Told Mistress Ansell of dying in the second act
